title: Backflow preventer repair kit: match the exact model and size first
description: A repair kit is only valid when manufacturer, model, nominal size, and failed component are known.
prompt: What exact assembly and service family does this kit need to fit?
answer: A repair kit is only valid when manufacturer, model, nominal size, and failed component are known. Similar-looking assemblies can use different internal parts and service procedures.
urgency: Do not order a generic or universal kit from a photo. Escalate missing labels, obsolete products, body damage, and uncertain part compatibility.
identifiers: The model label and nominal size are the primary compatibility keys.
A check kit, relief kit, cover kit, and complete service kit are not interchangeable scopes.
A kit does not include isolation, labor, retest, or required report filing.

choices.detail: Document the location and obtain a qualified diagnosis before repair.

steps.title: Observe and identify
steps.body: Capture the full label and each serviceable section before searching parts.

steps.title: Close the risk loop
steps.body: Include qualified installation and a required post-repair test in the final plan.
